title: Protologue: A Taxonomy of Prompting and LLM Techniques
description:
Protologue is an openly licensed, sourced reference for the vocabulary of prompting and large language model techniques. Each entry has a permanent identifier (PTL-NNNN), a standalone one-to-two-sentence definition, synonyms, broader, narrower and related links (SKOS semantics), and the primary source that introduced the technique.

Version 1.2.0 contains 211 terms in 11 branches (foundations, exemplars, reasoning, verification, retrieval and tools, agents, optimization, test-time compute, security, failure modes and evaluation, and benchmarks), citing 209 primary sources. Every arXiv citation and documentation link was checked against the source.

This archive contains the source data (YAML), the generator that builds the website and its machine-readable exports (JSON, CSV, SKOS JSON-LD and Turtle, llms.txt), and an MCP server for AI agents. The live reference is at https://protologue.com/.
notes: Text and data are licensed CC BY 4.0. The generator and MCP server code are licensed MIT.
